attributions.surface_quote: numerous influences and conditions which appear to be associated with the arrival of the Adjusters

attributions.surface_quote: they quietly... arrive at the decision to begin the pursuit of the doing of the will

attributions.surface_quote: acting independently in the minds of the children of men

attributions.surface_quote: must be diverse manifestations of the same divinity

attributions.surface_quote: function in accordance with universe laws quite apart... in perfect synchrony and co-ordination

attributions.surface_quote: representative of the Universal Father’s direct and unexplained contact with the creatures
